newsitem.title: CHINA: China set to open new airport in Nanjing.
newsitem.headline: China set to open new airport in Nanjing.

text.p: The first phase of a new international airport in China's eastern city of Nanjing was due to start operating on Tuesday, the China Daily said.
The initial phase of the Nanjing Lukou International Airport, including one 3,600-metre runway, was capable of handling 8.6 million passengers and 119,800 tonnes of freight annually, it said.
The Nanjing Lukou International Airport Co Ltd had already invested 2.3 billion yuan ($277 million) in the airport, the newspaper said.

The airport, designed to meet increasing demand for air transport, would eventually have two runways and handle 40 million passengers and one million tonnes of cargo annually, it said without giving a date for completion of the project.
A 29-kilometre expressway had also been built linking the airport to the centre of Nanjing, the newspaper said.
